title: THE COMICS LOUNGE
tickerText:
WELCOME TO THE COMICS LOUNGE, MELBOURNE'S HOME OF LIVE COMEDY SINCE 2000 AND AUSTRALIA'S BIGGEST STAND-UP COMEDY VENUE!

RECENTLY VOTED THE 7TH BEST COMEDY CLUB IN THE WORLD, THE COMICS LOUNGE HAS BEEN DELIVERING UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS OF LAUGHTER FOR OVER 25 YEARS.

WITH A MASSIVE 400-SEAT CAPACITY, THIS ICONIC NORTH MELBOURNE VENUE SHOWCASES THE VERY BEST AUSTRALIAN AND INTERNATIONAL COMEDIANS, FROM LEGENDARY HEADLINERS TO THE HOTTEST EMERGING TALENT.

ENJOY OVER TWO HOURS OF SIDE-SPLITTING ENTERTAINMENT, HILARIOUS OBSERVATIONS, OUTRAGEOUS STORIES AND WORLD-CLASS STAND-UP COMEDY, WITH LIVE SHOWS MOST NIGHTS OF THE WEEK.

MAKE A NIGHT OF IT WITH DELICIOUS DINING OPTIONS, DRINKS AND A FANTASTIC ATMOSPHERE. CHOOSE FROM A GREAT SELECTION OF ENTREES, MAINS AND DESSERTS BEFORE SETTLING IN FOR AN EVENING OF NON-STOP LAUGHTER.

CONVENIENTLY LOCATED JUST MINUTES FROM MELBOURNE'S CBD, THE COMICS LOUNGE IS THE PERFECT DESTINATION FOR DATE NIGHTS, CELEBRATIONS, GROUP OUTINGS OR A BRILLIANT NIGHT WITH FRIENDS.

FIND US AT LEVEL 1, 26 ERROL STREET, NORTH MELBOURNE.

THE COMICS LOUNGE – BIG NAMES, BIG LAUGHS AND UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS!

channelMasterConfig.tickerText: WELCOME TO THE COMICS LOUNGE, MELBOURNE'S HOME OF LIVE COMEDY SINCE 2000 AND AUSTRALIA'S BIGGEST STAND-UP COMEDY VENUE! • RECENTLY VOTED THE 7TH BEST COMEDY CLUB IN THE WORLD, THE COMICS LOUNGE HAS BEEN DELIVERING UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS OF LAUGHTER FOR OVER 25 YEARS. • WITH A MASSIVE 400-SEAT CAPACITY, THIS ICONIC NORTH MELBOURNE VENUE SHOWCASES THE VERY BEST AUSTRALIAN AND INTERNATIONAL COMEDIANS, FROM LEGENDARY HEADLINERS TO THE HOTTEST EMERGING TALENT. • ENJOY OVER TWO HOURS OF SIDE-SPLITTING ENTERTAINMENT, HILARIOUS OBSERVATIONS, OUTRAGEOUS STORIES AND WORLD-CLASS STAND-UP COMEDY, WITH LIVE SHOWS MOST NIGHTS OF THE WEEK. • MAKE A NIGHT OF IT WITH DELICIOUS DINING OPTIONS, DRINKS AND A FANTASTIC ATMOSPHERE. CHOOSE FROM A GREAT SELECTION OF ENTREES, MAINS AND DESSERTS BEFORE SETTLING IN FOR AN EVENING OF NON-STOP LAUGHTER. • CONVENIENTLY LOCATED JUST MINUTES FROM MELBOURNE'S CBD, THE COMICS LOUNGE IS THE PERFECT DESTINATION FOR DATE NIGHTS, CELEBRATIONS, GROUP OUTINGS OR A BRILLIANT NIGHT WITH FRIENDS. • FIND US AT LEVEL 1, 26 ERROL STREET, NORTH MELBOURNE. • THE COMICS LOUNGE – BIG NAMES, BIG LAUGHS AND UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS!
